name: Slovak mountains and peaks (vrchy)
title: Slovak mountains and peaks (vrchy)
description: Mountains, peaks, and other major mountain features located in Slovakia, sourced from Wikidata (instance of mountain Q8502, country Slovakia Q214). Includes elevation, prominence, isolation, coordinates, mountain range affiliation, Wikipedia links across Central European languages, and Wikimedia Commons images. Notable peaks include Gerlachovský štít (2654 m, highest in Slovakia), Lomnický štít, Kriváň (Slovak national symbol), Ďumbier, and Rysy — spanning the Vysoké Tatry, Nízke Tatry, Malá Fatra, Veľká Fatra, Slovenský raj, and other Slovak mountain ranges.

meta.title: Slovak mountains and peaks (vrchy) - Bezplatné stiahnutie
meta.description: Mountains, peaks, and other major mountain features located in Slovakia, sourced from Wikidata (instance of mountain Q8502, country Slovakia Q214). Includes elevation, prominence, isolation, coordinates, mountain range affiliation, Wikipedia links across Central European languages, and Wikimedia Commons images. Notable peaks include Gerlachovský štít (2654 m, highest in Slovakia), Lomnický štít, Kriváň (Slovak national symbol), Ďumbier, and Rysy — spanning the Vysoké Tatry, Nízke Tatry, Malá Fatra, Veľká Fatra, Slovenský raj, and other Slovak mountain ranges. Obsahuje 1720 záznamov. Stiahnuť vo formátoch Excel, CSV, PDF.
